hypotheses.text: The first desktop tests fail because the e2e dev server restores the persisted Turbopack dev cache in .next/dev/cache/turbopack written by a next dev on other code, and pages served from it reload in a loop; with experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev off for the e2e server (ATLAS_ENV=test), the desktop account and catalog specs pass on the same stale cache that failed them in two runs (7 and 8 failures)

note: E2E-001 implemented and tested locally 2026-11-02 (not committed to main, not accepted): the desktop e2e failures were pages reloading in a loop from a Turbopack dev cache persisted on other code; next.config.ts turns that cache off for the e2e server (ATLAS_ENV=test) and the DS-002 visual warm-up is removed. test:e2e 123/123 twice in a row, npm run check exit 0. Open: Next 16.4.0 agent upgrade notice (owner decision, OPEN_GAPS E6).
